findings.text: the record commit subject carries the plan slug as its scope (docs(crew-observability-truth): ...), a plan identifier in a commit message that the worker's own dispatch contract rule six and the user-global no-plan-references-in-commits rule forbid; the code commit's fix(crew): subject is clean and the habit is repo-wide (docs(plans) and docs(monitor-renders-what-it-is-given) appear in recent history), so it is docked one rather than read as a lone slip.

the base reading is worded as 180 passed 0 failed with the base reader, which cannot describe the added cases run against the base reader, so a reader comparing 180 and 187 cannot tell whether the base figure is the base revision or the new tests against the base reader; the fail-at-base half of the done-when is evidenced only by base_fixtures_probe.log, a hand probe rather than a suite run of the added cases.

the crash regression case asserts failure_ids is None, which is the typed-scalar loss recorded as a follow-on rather than the behaviour this node decided, so a later repair of that loss has to edit this test; the sequence-key arm of _decode_mapping_key (reckon/crew/reports.py:472) has no case.

justifications.durability: Six committed regression cases are each built from the real text of a named corpus manifest and each fails at the node's base (tests/test_manifest_declared_schema.py:215,233,252,274,307 — I reproduced four refusals and the TypeError there myself), and the two negative-half tests at lines 75 and 93 hold the four schema defects fixed; docked one because the unhashable-key guard's sequence-key arm is untested and the crash case asserts failure_ids is None, which pins the recorded typed-scalar follow-on rather than asserting the field reads as the worker's own text.
justifications.evidence: The done-when's gate is recorded as receipts at both revisions — head_gate.log 187 passed 0 failed in 56.79s and base_gate.log 180 passed in 33.25s, 180-to-187 matching the net seven added cases — and I re-derived the central corpus figure myself plus the fail-at-base reproduction for five of the six fixtures and the TypeError; docked one because the manifest and the plan record word the base reading as 180 passed 0 failed "with the base reader", which cannot describe the added cases run against the base reader (I measured four of them refusing and one crashing there), so the fail-at-base half rests on base_fixtures_probe.log, a hand probe, while the suite figures are base revision against head revision (manifest.md:14).
justifications.fit: The reader change follows the module's existing idiom — a small extracted helper at reckon/crew/reports.py:439, the compose-don't-retype rule kept, and the module docstring stating what a mapping in a list field now means — and the new symbols and comments carry no plan labels, the H200 and run-id strings being verbatim corpus text quoted as fixtures; docked one because the record commit's subject uses the plan slug as its scope, docs(crew-observability-truth), which the dispatch contract's rule six and the user-global no-plan-references-in-commits rule forbid.
justifications.goal_fidelity: Reproduced independently at the reviewed head rather than taken from the worker's account: my own re-run of the 27 paths in reader-regression-corpus.txt reads 27 ok / 0 bad / 0 missing, and a direct base-versus-head probe of the refusal shapes and the crashing form shows test_logs, artifacts, commits and changed_paths each raising ManifestParseError at fee111c4 and reading at 8033817b, the braced mapping key raising TypeError at fee111c4 and reading at 8033817b, and the two negative-half defects (a three-commit list whose last subject carries a comma; a nested mapping under tests) reading identically at both revisions (reckon/crew/reports.py:516).
justifications.scope_discipline: The diff is exactly the four declared write paths — reckon/crew/reports.py 61/20, tests/test_manifest_declared_schema.py 171/13, docs/plans/crew-observability-truth.html 27/0, docs/evidence/archive/crew-observability-truth-landed.html 95/0 — both doc edits are insertion-only so the section tree and the plan meta lines are untouched, the reviewed worktree was clean at its head, and both commits reached main through the coordinator's merge e88d2fcb rather than a worker push.
